Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer relied on an incomplete and noisy Bing results list that mixed in out-of-state gyms (Mount Pleasant, SC) and did not follow up on more comprehensive local sources (e.g., the visible Yelp listing) or refine the search to ensure coverage of gyms in West Virginia within the specified radius. This oversight omitted The Root Sports & Fitness Center and led the workflow to proceed with an incomplete set, resulting in the wrong final answer.
